from pptx import Presentation
from copy import deepcopy
from lxml import etree

TEMPLATE = "${DEMO}/company-decks/brand/company-design-template.pptx"
OUT = "${DEMO}/company-decks/sprint-2-review.pptx"

prs = Presentation(TEMPLATE)

# Wipe example slides from template so we start clean but keep masters/layouts.
sldIdLst = prs.slides._sldIdLst
for sldId in list(sldIdLst):
    rId = sldId.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id")
    prs.part.drop_rel(rId)
    sldIdLst.remove(sldId)

layouts = {l.name: l for l in prs.slide_layouts}


def set_ph(slide, idx, text_lines):
    ph = slide.placeholders[idx]
    tf = ph.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    for i, line in enumerate(text_lines):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = line


# Slide 1: Title
s1 = prs.slides.add_slide(layouts["Title"])
set_ph(s1, 0, ["Sprint 2 review"])
set_ph(s1, 1, ["Team Skycast · milestone closed 2026-09-18 · 7/7 items, 0 spillover"])

# Slide 2: Offline forecast
s2 = prs.slides.add_slide(layouts["Content"])
set_ph(s2, 0, ["Offline forecast"])
set_ph(s2, 1, [
    "Issue #6 → PR #7",
    "Last forecast cached on device",
    "Shown when network is unavailable",
    "Need: keep useful info on trains, planes, tunnels",
])

# Slide 3: No-location crash fix
s3 = prs.slides.add_slide(layouts["Content"])
set_ph(s3, 0, ["No-location crash fix"])
set_ph(s3, 1, [
    "Issue #8 → PR #9",
    "App crashed on launch when location services were off",
    "Now falls back to last known location",
    "Impact: stops immediate-exit for users who deny location",
])

# Slide 4: °C / °F setting
s4 = prs.slides.add_slide(layouts["Content"])
set_ph(s4, 0, ["°C / °F setting"])
set_ph(s4, 1, [
    "Issue #10 → PR #11",
    "User-selectable temperature unit",
    "Overrides the region default",
    "Reported by travellers who want their home unit abroad",
])

# Slide 5: Wrap + Sprint 3 look-ahea… [truncated 317 chars]
